questions.q: Which of the following is Pakistan's largest commercial bank?
questions.explanation: Habib Bank Limited (HBL) is widely recognised as Pakistan's largest commercial bank.

questions.q: A current account in a bank generally ___
questions.explanation: Current accounts are meant for frequent transactions and normally pay no interest.

questions.q: The main role of the State Bank of Pakistan is to ___
questions.explanation: The State Bank is Pakistan's central bank, regulating monetary policy and banks.
ATM stands for Automated Teller Machine, used for cash withdrawals and basic services.

questions.q: A savings account is mainly useful because it ___
questions.explanation: Savings accounts pay profit (interest) on the money deposited in them.

questions.q: A cheque is best described as ___
questions.explanation: A cheque is a written instruction to the bank to pay a stated sum to a person.

questions.q: A fixed (term) deposit differs from a savings account because ___
options: money is locked for a fixed period
questions.explanation: In a fixed deposit the money stays with the bank for a set term, usually earning higher profit.

questions.q: An overdraft facility allows a customer to ___
options: withdraw more than the account balance
questions.explanation: An overdraft lets an account holder withdraw beyond the available balance up to an agreed limit.

questions.q: Which of these is a well-known instant digital payment system in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Raast is Pakistan's instant payment system enabling quick bank-to-bank transfers.
KYC (Know Your Customer) is the process banks use to verify a customer's identity.
